# GitHub Copilot instructions for Solidarity Framework

Read the [organization Copilot instructions](https://github.com/NeuroLift-Technologies/.github/blob/main/.github/copilot-instructions.md) and the [public governance contract](../GOVERNANCE.md).

For repository-specific coordination, read [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md), [CLAUDE.md](../CLAUDE.md) and [active threads](../docs/active-threads.md). Register before significant work, use a feature branch and open a pull request for review. Record the handoff under `docs/agent-log/handoffs/`.
